scene.language: Okay, in this scenario, the defendants will raise their hand to signal that they need parts. We will transfer the part to the employee who raised his hand first. If they are raised at the same moment, we will first give[0][1][2][3][4] the[5][6] part to Employee B, and then we will give the part to Employee A, as Employee B is closer to us. Okay, Employee B raised his hand first, so we transfer the object to him first. And now we can move the object to Employee A. The end.
